workflow_guid.title: Workflow Guid
workflow_guid.description: GUID of the workflow containing the node.

workflow_name.title: Workflow Name
workflow_name.description: Name of the workflow containing the node.

template_id.title: Template Id
template_id.description: Identifier of the catalog adapter the node follows.

current_version.title: Current Version
current_version.description: Adapter version the node holds. Empty for one published before adapters carried versions.

available_version.title: Available Version
available_version.description: Adapter version the catalog's checkout now publishes.

running.title: Running
running.description: True when the runtime has this node starting, running, or stopping - it cannot be updated until it is stopped. Always false when the runtime could not be reached.

pinned.title: Pinned
pinned.description: True when the node has a run-from-commit pin, which an update clears - what runs would otherwise not change.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: Nodes in the project whose adapter has a newer release.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Every accessible project holding a node behind its adapter.

inaccessible_projects.title: Inaccessible Projects
inaccessible_projects.description: How many further projects hold such a node but were left out because the caller does not collaborate on them.

runtime_available.title: Runtime Available
runtime_available.description: False when the runtime could not be reached, in which case `running` is false throughout.
